articles.title: Bitget Confirms $351.6 Million Hot Wallet Hack, Suspends Withdrawals
articles.summary:
Crypto exchange Bitget has confirmed unauthorized transfers from part of its hot wallet infrastructure, resulting in estimated losses of about $351.6 million. articles.title: Duelbits Confirms $7 Million Hot-Wallet Hack, forcing Systems offline
articles.summary:
Crypto casino Duelbits has confirmed a cybersecurity breach that drained approximately $7 million from its hot wallets, forcing the platform offline while investigators establish the attack’s root cause.
